```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

COVID_19 <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-COVID-download.csv")

gt(head(COVID_19))
# head() function visualises just the first 10 lines of data
```

```{r}
COVID_19 <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-COVID-download.csv")

ggplot(COVID_19, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "cyan") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Cases per 100000 people") +
  ggtitle("COVID-19 Cases by Date")

```
